Class SyncedPanel

java.lang.Object
com.sbancuz.offscreen.integration.mui2.SyncedPanel
public final class SyncedPanel extends Object
Common-side declarations for a server-authoritative ModularUI panel. Register the same frozen declaration once on both sides. Values are transient per session; named slots bind existing server storage. Client handlers are only native protocol mirrors, never authoritative inventories. Minecraft still permits one active synchronized container per player.
